properties.description: The degraded surface comes out of the door the caller asked for: with the graph genuinely held by another process AND --http given, an HTTP client still completes the handshake, still finds the reason in its instructions, and can still call reflow2_unavailable — plus the startup line says DEGRADED rather than letting an operator read 'serving over HTTP' and walk away. 4 cases in tools/test_degraded_server.py, measured against a real held lock.
properties.findings: It caught the fault it was written for: against the v0.14.0 code all four fail with 'nothing ever listened on the port the caller asked for', because main.rs's Err arm called serve(stdio()) and never read cli.http (BL-105).
properties.name: The degraded surface comes out of the door the caller asked for
